1.web: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”
1.asv: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice; for they will say, Jehovah hath not appeared unto thee.

2.web: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
2.asv: And Jehovah said unto him, What is that in thy hand? And he said, A rod.

3.web: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
3.asv: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

4.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
4.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Put forth thy hand, and take it by the tail: (and he put forth his hand, and laid hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand);

5.web: “That they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
5.asv: that they may believe that Jehovah, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

6.web: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
6.asv: And Jehovah said furthermore unto him, Put now thy hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.

7.web: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
7.asv: And he said, Put thy hand into thy bosom again. (And he put his hand into his bosom again; and when he took it out of his bosom, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.)

8.web: “It will happen, if they will neither believe you nor listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
8.asv: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

9.web: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs, neither listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
9.asv: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe even these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

10.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
10.asv: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Oh, Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

11.web: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
11.asv: And Jehovah said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh a man dumb, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? is it not I, Jehovah?

12.web: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
12.asv: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt speak.

13.web: He said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
13.asv: And he said, Oh, Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

14.web: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he comes out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
14.asv: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is there not Aaron thy brother the Levite? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

15.web: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
15.asv: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put the words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

16.web: He will be your spokesman to the people; and it will happen, that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
16.asv: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people; and it shall come to pass, that he shall be to thee a mouth, and thou shalt be to him as God.

17.web: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
17.asv: And thou shalt take in thy hand this rod, wherewith thou shalt do the signs.

18.web: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
18.asv: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren that are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

19.web: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
19.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt; for all the men are dead that sought thy life.

20.web: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
20.asv: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

21.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
21.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, When thou goest back into Egypt, see that thou do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in thy hand: but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.

22.web: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Thus says Yahweh, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
22.asv: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith Jehovah, Israel is my son, my first-born:

23.web: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me”; and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your son, your firstborn.’”
23.asv: and I have said unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me; and thou hast refused to let him go: behold, I will slay thy son, thy first-born.

24.web: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.
24.asv: And it came to pass on the way at the lodging-place, that Jehovah met him, and sought to kill him.

25.web: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
25.asv: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, Surely a bridegroom of blood art thou to me.

26.web: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
26.asv: So he let him alone. Then she said, A bridegroom of blood art thou, because of the circumcision.

27.web: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
27.asv: And Jehovah said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mountain of God, and kissed him.

28.web: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
28.asv: And Moses told Aaron all the words of Jehovah wherewith he had sent him, and all the signs wherewith he had charged him.

29.web: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
29.asv: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

30.web: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
30.asv: and Aaron spake all the words which Jehovah had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

31.web: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
31.asv: And the people believed: and when they heard that Jehovah had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
